notes.walker:2026-07-05:rosy-simas-a-gaje-gwah: Seneca Nation artist Rosy Simas weaves moving image, sound, and handwoven vessels into a room built for a peaceful mind.
notes.crooners:2026-07-05:colleen-raye-and-phi: Vocalist Colleen Raye and veteran Twin Cities jazz pianist Phil Aaron settle in for an intimate evening of standards.
notes.icehouse:2026-07-05:salsa-w-charanga-tro: Charanga Tropical brings Cuban charanga to the courtyard, violins and flute riding over sizzling salsa from a longtime Minneapolis band.
notes.crooners:2026-07-05:django-reinhardt-fin: Guitarist Ryan Picone and his quartet play the jazz manouche of Django Reinhardt, the swinging Romani-French guitar tradition.
notes.crooners:2026-07-05:lori-dokken-presents: Pianist Lori Dokken gathers Twin Cities vocalists for a night of song and spoken word about democracy and hope.
notes.dakota:2026-07-05:natania-and-ticket-to-: Brazilian vocalist Natania Kamin and Ticket to Brasil bring bossa nova and samba, the warm sound of her native Brazil.
notes.crooners:2026-07-05:johnnie-brown-let-th: Twin Cities soul singer Johnnie Brown honors Barry White, channeling that lush bass voice and seventies R&B swagger.
notes.icehouse:2026-07-05:sorry-oga-single-rel: Obi Original and The Black Atlantics mark a single release with Nigerian Afrobeat and highlife from their Minneapolis collective.
notes.whitesquirrel:2026-07-05:joe-nicola-w-th: Virtuoso fingerstyle guitarist Joe Nicola shares the night with The Get-Up Mondays, whose songs lean toward Petty-style roots rock.
notes.331:2026-07-05:brass-messengers: The Brass Messengers, a ten-piece Minneapolis street band, roll through Balkan, Caribbean, and African grooves on twisted brass.
